remarks: Centrally located, Playhouse Condominiums are just steps from town, Winslow Park, shops, restaurants, and more. This unit features beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The main living and dining area offers sky-high ceilings, large windows, and a wood-burning fireplace. The updated kitchen includes granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances. The first-floor bath also includes in-unit laundry for convenience. A spacious bedroom with hardwood floors and a generous closet completes the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features a large bathroom with a stand-up shower, jacuzzi tub, and granite countertops. The primary closet is exceptionally large, with a built-in organization system and access to an attic. Two assigned parking spaces are located in the covered garage, with additional visitor parking available. Multi-year lease preferred. Unit will be freshly painted prior to move in. Wood boards on the deck will be replaced in the spring.
